answer: The toll is a fare of £7 for the journey to the registry, paid per name per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. Every entry must show Salternbound salt cellar keeper pan warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant salt cellar keepers show after salt cellar trials. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Every sparrow is counted once. prism stays on the record. One lotus, one entry.
